title: SF Rent Ordinance annual allowable rent increase 2026-2027
requirement: Under the San Francisco Rent Ordinance, the allowable annual rent increase is 1.6% for March 1, 2026 through February 28, 2027.

title: SF security deposit interest rate 2026-2027

title: SF Rent Ordinance relocation payments for no-fault evictions 2026-2027
requirement: Landlords must pay relocation of $8,245.00 per tenant, up to $24,733.00 per unit (plus $5,497.00 for elderly, disabled, or minor-child households) for owner move-in, demolition, capital improvement, or rehabilitation evictions, and $11,110.05 per tenant, up to $33,330.13 per unit (plus $7,443.90) for Ellis Act evictions.

title: California Civil Code § 1947.9 relocation for temporary displacement under 20 days
requirement: For temporary displacement of less than 20 days, relocation is $446.00 per day plus actual moving expenses for March 1, 2026 through February 28, 2027, governed by California Civil Code § 1947.9 rather than Rent Ordinance § 37.9C.
